text:
maya: Heads up — around 10:02 UTC apiserver started throwing transient 502/504s for the GPU-scheduler path. Not full outage but we saw ~30% tail errors for ~4m :eyes:
elaine: seeing the same in traces, lots of retries and client-side timeouts. Any recent control-plane changes?
raj: rolled the kube-proxy daemonset in eu-west1 ~09:55 UTC for the ipvs -> iptables toggle. Could that correlate?
tom: hmm we also triggered an aggressive etcd compaction job at 09:50 as part of backup housekeeping. compaction spikes I/O.
maya: stack traces look like apiserver failing on proxying to kubelet / healthz for pods causing controller-manager to backoff GPU PodCreate requests. snippet of logs:
```
E0305 10:03:12.123456 1 handler.go:123] apiserver error: failed to proxy request "POST /api/v1/namespaces/default/pods" from 10.0.0.1: dial tcp 10.0.0.5:10250: i/o timeout
E0305 10:03:12.223456 1 trace.go:88] Trace[1234]: "Create Pod" (started: 2026-03-05 10:02:59.999) (total time: 153ms): 
```
elaine: looks like proxy table updates from kube-proxy were delayed, so apiserver couldn't reach kubelet endpoints and fell back to retries. iptables restore logs show delays.
raj: IPVS->iptables switch uses atomic iptables-restore which can spike conntracking. I/O + etcd compaction could've amplified the controlplane latency window.
tom: ops-bot shows spikes on apiserver handler latency and etcd disk pending ops at 09:51-09:55. ops-bot: 
```
[ops-bot] metric alert: apiserver_request_latency_p50 > 250ms (09:51-09:56), etcd_disk_pending_ops > 200ms (09:50-09:54)
```
maya: Immediate mitigation steps proposed: 1) revert kube-proxy toggle in eu-west1 (rolling pause) 2) pause non-critical etcd compactions for 30m 3) increase apiserver proxy-read timeout to avoid transient 5xxs 4) throttle GPU scheduler create retries
elaine: agree, start with reverting kube-proxy roll, I'm on it.
raj: pausing compaction now — disabled scheduled compactions for the cluster for 30m.
tom: applying kube-proxy rollback canary to 2 nodes first to confirm behavior. If we see apiserver tail errors drop we proceed full rollback.
maya: note for follow-up: need to add rate-limited kube-proxy updates during heavy etcd IO windows and improve coordination between infra jobs and control-plane maintenance. Also need a postmortem entry for the GPU scheduling errors (impact: slower pod creation, ~8% increased pod creation latency for ML jobs).
elaine: rollback canary looks good — 10m in and errors dropped to baseline. pushing full rollback now :thumbsup:
raj: compaction re-enabled with more conservative schedule for next window; will also add pre-checks for control-plane I/O.
tom: documenting temporary apiserver timeout bump and rollback in incident notes.
maya: thanks all — filing a short incident note. tagging infra and product: @platform and @ml-team for visibility. :white_check_mark:
